reference: Preserved Harbor Desktop 0.9.132 Beta profile-sync/engine.ts and layout-sync/store.ts
implementation: HarborProfileSync delegates authenticated household layout passes to HarborHouseholdLayoutSync; the legacy single-profile path remains available without a household context
incoming_order: services, nav, home, anime, then original response order within each section. Known profiles with absent documents still hydrate their own pending journals
shared_values: Linked profiles share persisted values. Independent profiles use their personal owner. Inactive actors never bind or replace the active navigation instance
visible_values: Refresh only the affected shared preference instance after an inactive projection, preserving its UI callbacks and editing state
independent_fallback: An independent profile with neither its own scoped value nor an explicit local override reads the account shared scope without creating a private record
origin: Atomically persist the local editing syncId with preferences; empty marks a remote projection and nil supports legacy records. Metadata stays outside native layout values and never enters wire sections
wire_identity: Only the edited profile's key becomes dirty. Previously queued keys coalesce against their current shared value as on Desktop; a local version displaced by another linked server section remains parked until explicitly restored
conflicts: Maintain independent CAS revisions and durable intents per profile document, preserve unknown Desktop fields and existing section-specific restore behavior
retirement: Account/selection/routing mutation and cancellation are checked before and after every send, before an actor can consume its acknowledgement
errors: Malformed sections do not block other sections/profiles; the actual HTTP network error stops the pass. Failed storage does not clear previously known pending status
performance: Index the incoming envelope once, avoid repeated writes for unchanged or absent sections, and keep all rendering free of Keychain reads

previous_run.failure: Owned identity assertion accessed optional guestAddons without unwrapping; corrected with an empty fallback
